about: This collect asks that we may follow Peter Martyr’s faith with fitting devotion. It recalls the palm of martyrdom he was worthy to win for spreading that same faith.

seg.tr: Almighty God, grant, we pray, that we may follow with fitting devotion the faith of blessed Peter, Your martyr, who was worthy to win the palm of martyrdom for spreading that same faith. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: the faith of blessed Peter, Your martyr
who lives and reigns with You

ex.w007: Peter here is Peter Martyr, not Peter the Apostle.
ex.w013: The request is to follow Peter’s faith with fitting devotion. Latin places “we may follow” after the phrase it governs. The full English prayer brings the verb earlier.
ex.w014: The relative clause returns to Peter. His past worthiness to win the martyr’s palm is set beside the present request to follow his faith.
ex.w039: The word “God” refers to the Son, who lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit.
